concerns.text: Functional Requirements FR‑010 and FR‑011 (3‑D baseline model and comparison) are listed in the spec but are marked as ‘out of scope’ in the plan without any implementation, test, or contract artifact. The spec still expects these FRs to be satisfied, so they are currently unbacked.

Success Criterion SC‑008 (ΔR² between 2‑D and 3‑D baseline) is referenced in the spec but the plan notes it is omitted/flagged and provides no script, data artifact, or test to compute this metric, leaving the SC unaddressed.
The plan’s Complexity Tracking table includes SC‑008 but marks it as omitted, meaning the required ΔR² calculation is not implemented, violating full spec coverage.
